title: Tropical storm
tldr: Treat tropical storm warnings seriously: dangerous flooding, surge, wind and tornadoes can occur. Check local evacuation instructions, avoid flooded roads, and take shelter before conditions become unsafe.
steps: Check flood, surge and tornado notices as well as wind forecasts.
Charge devices, secure loose outdoor items while safe and arrange essential medicines and supplies.
Follow the evacuation zone and route instructions for your address.
Stay off roads during hazardous weather and never drive into floodwater.
next: Monitor updates after the storm passes; rivers may keep rising and power lines may remain live.
watch: A storm below hurricane strength can still cause catastrophic flooding.
review_status: source-linked editorial review; not independent expert certification
without_help: Prepare for loss of water, electricity and communications even if the storm is not a hurricane. Move out of flood and surge areas before access is lost. Do not use the storm name or wind category as proof that your route or home is safe.
household: Account for children, older people, pets and anyone who needs assistance before moving. Keep shoes, medicines and a torch in the shelter area. Decide who helps whom and who carries the essential supplies; do not send a lone child to retrieve items.
pack_now: Keep essential medicines, drinking water, a battery light, shoes, phone power and a written contact card within reach. Adapt the load to the hazard and the people with you; do not delay escape to collect equipment.
